verdict.rationale: Snyk IaC is a first-party product line that scans Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes and ARM configurations. It works across IDE, SCM, CLI and Terraform Cloud/Enterprise workflows, gives fix advice, and supports custom Rego rules through an SDK. The GitHub README separately confirms that it finds insecure configurations in Terraform and Kubernetes code. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of IaC scan quality; the community items do not address IaC at all.
